decision.explanation: Similar: Q01 best matches C04 (tight_bearing). Under the required calibrated rule, C04 has the smallest query distance, 2.261814 dB, and is the only reference whose distance is within its own threshold (2.463183 dB). C01, C02 and C03 exceed their thresholds. Figures and measurements support the decision through the shared persistent approximately 16 kHz spectral ridge, high-frequency-weighted band distribution, matching short-lag periodicity and stable 10 s evolution. Q01's carrier is shifted downward by about 42.6 Hz and has greater power above 8 kHz, but at the Welch resolution that shift is about one bin and does not overturn the closest gain-centered spectral-shape match.
